message_1_subject: Mutual action plan & POC readiness — Sapphire Data
message_1_body:
Hi Alex / Maya,

Thanks for the time today — good discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. Please flag anything I missed.

High-level pain / goals (from our notes):
- Current triage & enrichment pipeline is slow at scale; SLA misses on customer-support tasks.
- Goal: reduce average end-to-end triage latency from ~18 hours to <2 hours for high-priority cases.
- Need strong data isolation and auditability for PII-sensitive records in the triage flow.

Proposed POC scope (30 days):
1) Ingest: connect a small sample (50k rows) of anonymized ticket data.
2) Inference: deploy a Redwood-hosted endpoint running a quantized model for intent classification + summary extraction.
3) Eval & prompts: seed prompt set (20 canonical prompts) + automated evals for precision/recall and hallucination checks.
4) Ops: measure latency percentiles (p50/p95), throughput, and cost per 1k requests.

Success metrics (what we'll measure):
- Latency: p95 < 800ms for per-request inference in pilot traffic pattern.
- Quality: classification recall >= 92% on labeled set; summary ROUGE-L > 0.45 vs. human baseline.
- Economics: target cost <= $0.12 per 1k tokens for typical workload after batching/caching.

Owners & roles:
- Customer technical lead: Alex Rivera (Sapphire) — data & infra owner for sample dataset + access.
- Customer product contact: Maya Singh — product acceptance & business metrics.
- Redwood SRE / SE: Monica Patel — runtime config, access, eval harness.
- Redwood Solutions Eng: Karthik Iyer — prompt engineering and eval definitions.
- Redwood AE: Sean Gallagher — project lead and commercial owner.

Immediate asks from you (by EOD Friday):
- Confirm the sample dataset (S3 path or secure share) and point-of-contact for VPN/KMS access.
- Confirm acceptance criteria above or suggest edits.

Attachments: I prepared a 1-page mutual action plan (Sapphire-MAP-v1.xlsx) and a short access checklist.

Proposed timeline (rough):
- Week 0 (this week): data access & environment setup.
- Week 1: model selection + prompt seed + initial runs.
- Week 2: evaluations + tweak prompts.
- Week 3: performance tuning and cost profiling.
- Week 4: acceptance run & handoff doc.

If that looks reasonable I'll convert the attachment into a shared MAP and lock in a kickoff slot next week (Mon/Tue windows are open).

Thanks again — looking forward to getting started.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachment(s): Sapphire-MAP-v1.xlsx (draft), access-checklist.txt
message_2_subject: Re: Mutual action plan & POC readiness — Sapphire Data
message_2_body:
Thanks Sean — good summary and aligned. A few clarifications and notes: 

1) Data: we'll provide an S3 path with anonymized tickets and a smaller 'gold' labeled subset (2k rows) for evaluation. I'll send the IAM role and temporary creds to the shared secure bucket; see attachment sapphire_env_access.txt.
2) Security: we need Redwood's SOC2 cert and an outline of KMS integration for the POC — Monica, can you confirm how we handle keys for this pilot?
3) Timeline: we prefer a kickoff on Tuesday (Dec 8) to give our infra team time to prepare.
4) Acceptance tweak: can we add a business acceptance metric: reduction in average time-to-first-response for high-priority that we can measure via daily sample?

I'll loop Tom (infra) if you need VPC peering details.

Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Engineering, Sapphire Data
alex.rivera@sapphiredata.com
